links.outcome: Zero-shot MLLM feature recognition versus fine-tuned CNN and ViT baselines on seizure videos
links.effect: MLLMs outperformed fine-tuned CNN and ViT baseline models on 13 of 18 features without task-specific training.
links.quote: MLLMs outperformed fine-tuned Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Vision Transformer (ViT) baseline models on 13 of 18 features without task-specific training, demonstrating particular strength in recognizing salient postural and contextual features while struggling with subtle, high-frequency movements.

links.outcome: Expert-rated faithfulness of MLLM-generated explanations for correctly predicted cases
links.effect: 94.3 percent of MLLM explanations for correctly predicted cases achieved at least 60 percent faithfulness scores, aligning with epileptologist reasoning.
links.quote: Expert evaluation showed that 94.3 percent of MLLM-generated explanations for correctly predicted cases achieved at least 60 percent faithfulness scores, aligning with epileptologist reasoning.

unlisted_practices: Feature-targeted signal preprocessing (facial cropping, pose estimation, audio denoising) to improve MLLM performance on specific features

screen.reason: This study evaluates the capability of multimodal LLMs to recognize seizure semiology from clinical videos, including expert evaluation of generated explanations, but evaluates model performance rather than testing an organizational deployment practice or operational guardrail.
